weather_report:
As the night deepens over Boston, a gentle dance of clouds swirls in the sky, hinting at the rain showers that may grace the city before the moon rises high. Though the air remains warm, the promise of moisture holds sway, whispering of a possible thunderstorm in the stillness. With temperatures hovering around 60 degrees, a light jacket or a cozy sweater will do well to ward off the evening chill, while those venturing outside may want to keep an umbrella close at hand, just in case the skies decide to open.

Looking toward Wednesday, the dawn is set to unveil a canvas of patchy fog, a transient veil that will lift to reveal a day of brilliance. By midday, the sun will break through, warming the scene to a pleasant 77 degrees. They say the west wind will playfully tease with gusts, making it an invigorating day for a stroll along the Charles. A midday coffee, enjoyed outdoors, as the sun scatters its golden light, will soothe the spirit. Perhaps a leisurely wander through the gardens or a quiet moment in one of Boston's charming parks will invite reflection and maintain a pleasant pace. In these moments, one can embrace the grace of the day—here lies a sweet balance between the remnants of the night's whispers and the promises of warmth ahead.
